info.title: Духтари хубам API
info.description: One backend for Android, Web and the Admin Panel. Authenticate with Supabase Auth and send the access token as a Bearer token.

get.summary: CMS-managed UI strings and help texts (the “!” popovers)
The seven schools in CMS order
School by id or slug, with its courses and progress
Course with modules → topics → lessons outline
Published lesson as ordered content blocks
Search schools, courses, modules, topics and lessons
Current Daily Inspiration (null when none is published)

post.summary: Short-lived URL for a premium (protected) file; storage policies check the entitlement
Start (or resume) an attempt. The answer key is never included.

get.summary: Attempt result (with feedback per quiz policy)

post.summary: Check one answer immediately (only when the quiz shows feedback after each question)
Submit answers; the backend grades them

get.summary: Learning statistics, school progress and achievements
Saved lessons, optionally filtered by school

post.summary: Mark a notification read
Register a push token (Android/Web)

get.summary: Public settings the installed app reads at run time (Google sign-in client ID, whether to ask for the birthday)
Whole published catalogue for offline use (lessons, quizzes with answer keys, texts); send If-None-Match

post.summary: An error caught on a phone or in a browser (web/heal.ts), written to the server log; no personal data
Back up progress under the learner code; returns the merged progress (phone and backup combined)
Restore name and progress with the learner code (after reinstalling or on a new phone)

get.summary: Whether a login is free to take

post.summary: Set or change the login and password of the profile whose code is given
Sign in with login and password: name, progress and the encrypted code (or a new code issued by staff)
Write to support from this phone (no account needed); returns the thread
This phone's support thread (marks staff replies as read)
Number of unread staff replies for this phone
Rate the consultant of the conversation just closed (1–5, an optional note); returns the thread
Whether the account tied to this learner's code is a consultant, and how many conversations wait

get.summary: Whether Mahliyo AI can answer (the AI is set up on the server)

post.summary: A question to Mahliyo AI (the conversation so far, ending with the learner's question); returns her answer

get.summary: Every question learners asked Mahliyo AI, newest first
